messages:
Zoe: Evening crew — debating what to listen to while reading a short novel. low-key, no vocals if possible. any recs?
Amir: Solo piano or sparse guitar. Keith Jarrett "The Köln Concert" is a classic but long.
Hana: For shorter, try Agnes Obel or Nils Frahm 10-20 min pieces that don't grab you.
Poppy: If you want texture, sprinkle in a few field recordings between chapters. rain or subway ambience works.
Zoe: love that. can someone drop 30-40 min starter mixes?
Amir: made a 35-min mix: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/fake-evening-starters
Hana: Thread poll? which opener should Zoe try (react with :one: :two: :three:)?
BotPoll: Poll created by Hana: "Reading opener"  1) Nils Frahm solo piano; 2) Agnes Obel mellow pieces; 3) 30s field recording (rain) -> soft piano. Ends in 90m.
Poppy: voted :three:.
Amir: voted :one:.
Hana: voted :three:.
Zoe: voted :three: and :one:. I'll try the field intro tonight and report back which helps me focus. thanks :coffee:
